name: Icon List Block – create beautiful lists with icons instead of bullets
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Replace plain bullet points with eye-catching icon lists that highlight your features, services, and key information – no code required.

Icon List Block | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why Icon List Block?

Icon List Block lets you create clean, stylish, and highly customizable icon-based lists with ease. Choose from multiple themes, custom icons, badges, and layout options to highlight features, services, or key information – each list item supports its own link, animation, and advanced styling controls for full design flexibility.

It works seamlessly with the Full Site Editor and requires no external block libraries, so you get visually engaging, interactive content on any WordPress website without extra bloat.

Buy The Pro

Free Features

  • Comprehensive Customization Options: Arrange your list effortlessly with a wide range of settings tailored to your preferences.
  • Advanced Controls: Extensive controls for link management, rotation, alignment, colors, borders, padding, margins, and more.
  • Custom Icon Selection: Choose your preferred icon for each list item for a personalized touch.
  • Badge Title Configuration: Assign specific titles to list item badges for added context and detail.
  • Unlimited List Items: Add as many list items as you need, complete with customizable bullet points.
  • URL-Specific List Items: Define URLs for individual list items to make them interactive.
  • Theme Customization: Select from various themes to match your design preferences.
  • Quick Theme Options: Instantly switch between predefined styles to update the list appearance.
  • Full Site Editor Compatibility: Works perfectly with the Site Editor for a smooth editing experience.
  • No Block Library Dependency: Operates independently without requiring any additional block libraries.

Pro Version – Unlock More Design Power

Upgrade to Icon List Block Pro for advanced styling and animation:

  • Choose Your Preferred Theme: Personalize your lists with the theme that suits your style.
  • List Item Backgrounds: Customize the background of your list items.
  • Hide/Show List Item URL Icon: Toggle the visibility of URL icons per your design needs.
  • Hide/Show List Item Badge: Enable or disable badges to highlight content or keep things clean.
  • Badge Title Input Field: Display descriptive text alongside your list items.
  • Badge Text Styles: Customize typography – font style, size, weight, and spacing.
  • Badge Text Color & Background: Make badges stand out and complement your design.
  • Animated Icon Styles: Variant styles for the animated pulse effect to draw attention.
  • Custom Image Uploads: Use your own images as list icons.
  • Custom Grid Styles for Themes: Organize and display list items with precision.
  • Premium Animations: Exclusive smooth effects available only in Pro.

How to Use Icon List Block – Quick Start

  1. Install and activate the Icon List Block plugin.
  2. In the Gutenberg editor, add the Icon List block from the Widgets block category.
  3. Add your list items, pick icons, and set links or badges.
  4. Fine-tune colors, spacing, and themes from the right-side settings sidebar.
  5. Publish – enjoy!

Use Cases

  • Feature Lists: Present product or plugin features with meaningful icons.
  • Service Menus: Showcase your services with linked, styled list items.
  • Checklists & Benefits: Make key points scannable with icons and badges.
  • Navigation-Style Lists: Build icon-led link lists to guide visitors around your site.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Icon List Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. In the Gutenberg editor, search for the Icon List block and add it to any post or page.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Icon List Block plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, choose the icon-list-block.zip file, and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is Icon List Block free?

Yes, Icon List Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin. A Pro version with advanced styling and animations is also available.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings from the right sidebar of the Gutenberg block editor.

Can I add a link to each list item?

Yes. You can define a URL for each individual list item to make it interactive and clickable.

Does it work with the Full Site Editor?

Yes. Icon List Block is fully compatible with the WordPress Site Editor for a smooth editing experience.

Does it require any other block library plugin?

No. The plugin operates independently and does not require any additional block libraries.

How many list items can I add?

There is no limit – add as many list items as you need, and reuse the block unlimited times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Icon List Block plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
